title: Fibonacci EA v5.0 News Filter Disablement Test
research_question: Does disabling the synthetic news filter (InpUseNewsFilter = false) increase trade signal frequency from the baseline of 230 trades while keeping maximum equity drawdown within the 8.0% prop firm guard limit on GBPUSD M15?
hypothesis: Disabling the fixed-hour news filter will eliminate artificial session blackouts (around 08:30, 13:30, 14:00, 15:00 server time), allowing Fibonacci retracements during London and New York overlaps to execute, thereby increasing total trades by at least 25% (to >= 288 trades) without causing maximum equity drawdown to exceed 8.0%.

facts: EXP-0006 recorded exactly 230 trades across 124,311 bars on GBPUSD M15 under factory default inputs with InpUseNewsFilter=true.
EXP-0006 recorded 7.46% max equity drawdown and +$302.08 net profit.
inferences: The synthetic news filter suppresses trading for 60 minutes around hours 8, 13, 14, and 15, blocking significant portions of the active trading sessions.
Many valid Fibonacci retracement setups on M15 coincide with higher-volatility session overlap periods.

independent_variables.name: InpUseNewsFilter
independent_variables.rationale: Eliminates synthetic time-based trade suppression during London/NY trading sessions to determine true strategy frequency.

assumptions: EA swing detection and entry logic function reliably outside and during news event hours.
Deriv market history on GBPUSD M15 contains reliable 1-minute tick data for the entire 2020-2024 window.
expected_observations: Total trades will increase from 230 to at least 288 (>= 25% increase).
Max equity drawdown will remain <= 8.0% (inside prop firm buffer).
falsification_conditions: Total trades remain <= 230 after disabling the news filter.
Max equity drawdown exceeds 8.0%, breaching the prop firm guard threshold.
